headline: GOLD MINERS TRACKING NEAR-RECORD Q2 AT $2,787/oz PROFIT — 50% YoY SURGE, 12TH CONSECUTIVE BLOWOUT QUARTER; P/E COLLAPSES FROM 50x TO 20x AS EARNINGS OUTRUN STOCKS
snippet: Adam Hamilton's July 14 analysis quantifies what gold miners' near-record Q2 means in practice: with gold averaging ~$4,512/oz through the quarter at an estimated AISC of $1,725/oz, the GDX top 25 are tracking $2,787/oz in implied unit profits — the sector's second-best quarter ever and a 50% year-over-year improvement that marks the 12th consecutive quarter of outsized earnings growth. Despite those record-proximity profits and 87–113% YoY gains over recent quarters, the group's average trailing P/E has imploded from 49.6x after Q4 2023 to 20.2x in mid-May 2026, creating what Hamilton describes as the most severe valuation compression in a bull market cycle in modern memory — a structural setup that forces fundamentally-driven money to enter the sector as Q2 results are reported.

headline: TOREX RUNS 16 RIGS AND $43M AT MORELOS — ELG UNDERGROUND AND MEDIA LUNA DELIVER POSITIVE Q2 DRILL UPDATE; ATZCALA AND EL NARANJO REGIONAL TARGETS NOW ACTIVE (TSX:TXG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Torex Gold Resources Inc.
snippet: Torex Gold Resources Inc. (TSX: TXG) reported July 13 that its 16-rig fleet at the Morelos Complex in Guerrero, Mexico is executing on a $43 million, 113,500-metre annual drill program with continued positive results at ELG Underground and the Media Luna Cluster — reinforcing the organic growth thesis underlying Torex's reserve-replacement and mine-life extension strategy. Regional exploration has now been activated at priority targets Atzcala and El Naranjo, where 2026 programs are focused on confirming mineralization continuity and better defining the scale of two systems that could add meaningful upside beyond the current production footprint. The update comes as Torex reported Q2 production of 96,297 oz AuEq — below some analyst estimates, but consistent with the company's strategy of investing in long-term resource upside over short-term throughput maximization.

headline: STERLING METALS DRILLS 323m AT 0.34% CuEq FROM SURFACE — SOO COPPER'S MEPS ZONE PASSES 15,000m AS NORTHWEST AND WEST EXTENT CONFIRMED OPEN (TSXV:SAG)
source_name: Investing News Network / Sterling Metals Corp.
snippet: Sterling Metals Corp. (TSXV: SAG) announced July 13 that three additional drill holes at the MEPS Zone of the Soo Copper Project near Batchewana Bay, Ontario — holes SC-26-07, -08, and -09 — each returned 248–323 metres grading 0.30–0.34% copper-equivalent from surface, further defining the northwest and west margins of a broad near-surface copper system that has now passed 15,000 metres in a minimum 20,000-metre 2026 campaign totalling more than 25,000 metres since drilling began in spring 2025. The continuous copper mineralization from collar to end of hole in each new test reinforces Sterling's interpretation of a large, copper-dominant system with significant potential for higher-grade lenses within the defining envelope — a geometry well-suited to open-pit bulk-tonnage development in a tier-one Ontario jurisdiction.

headline: VALHALLA METALS OPENS DRILLS ON ALASKA'S AMBLER DISTRICT — SUN VMS TARGETS HIGH-GRADE CU-ZN-PB-AG-AU CONTINUITY ACROSS 10.7Mt RESOURCE (TSXV:VMXX)
source_name: Investing News Network / Valhalla Metals Inc.
snippet: Valhalla Metals Inc. (TSXV: VMXX) commenced July 13 its 2026 drill program at the Sun VMS Project in Alaska's Ambler Mining District, following up 2023 results that confirmed the continuity of high-grade copper-zinc-lead-gold-silver mineralisation across a combined resource of 1.71 million tonnes Indicated and 9.02 million tonnes Inferred. The Ambler District hosts some of North America's richest undeveloped polymetallic systems; Valhalla's program is designed to expand the Sun deposit and demonstrate the scale necessary to support a preliminary economic assessment, with Teck and Marubeni holding strategic stakes following a C$15 million financing and the acquisition of the adjacent Smucker Project in June 2026.

headline: ALL 5 HOLES HIT SULPHIDES IN CASCADE COPPER'S MAIDEN DRILL — CHALCOPYRITE EXCEEDS EXPECTATIONS AT CENTREFIRE VMS TARGET, NW ONTARIO (CSE:CASC)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Cascade Copper Corp.
snippet: Cascade Copper Corp. (CSE: CASC) reported July 13 that every hole in its maiden five-hole diamond drill program at the Centrefire Copper-Gold Project, 40 kilometres from Dryden in northwest Ontario, intersected sulphide mineralisation consistent with a Volcanogenic Massive Sulphide environment — with chalcopyrite content in holes CF-26-03, -04, and -05 exceeding management expectations. Assays are pending for holes 2–5 following priority submission from hole CF-26-01 on July 7; the 5-for-5 sulphide hit rate at first drill confirms the structural interpretation guiding target selection and opens the path to a maiden VMS resource definition program at a property with copper-gold anomalism across the target corridor.

headline: PREMIER AMERICAN URANIUM WRAPS CEBOLLETA DRILL PROGRAM — SAMPLES SHIPPED TO HAZEN RESEARCH FOR HEAP-LEACH RECOVERY OPTIMIZATION IN NEW MEXICO (TSXV:PUR)
snippet: Premier American Uranium Inc. (TSXV: PUR) completed July 13 its 2026 drilling program at the Cebolleta Uranium Project in New Mexico — recovering representative samples from the underground resource area — and delivered the material to Hazen Research, Inc. for comprehensive metallurgical testing designed to optimize heap-leach uranium recovery and inform a revised economic study. Cebolleta is one of New Mexico's best-delineated uranium deposits; the metallurgical program marks the last field work step before a revised economic assessment, and results are expected to support the company's advancement toward a production decision in a state that accounts for a historically significant share of U.S. domestic uranium output.

headline: CERRADO GOLD'S DON NICOLAS MINE POURS 15,415 GEO IN Q2 2026 — 11% ABOVE Q2 2025; H1 PRODUCTION UP 25% YEAR-OVER-YEAR FROM PATAGONIAN ARGENTINA (TSXV:CERT)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Cerrado Gold Inc.
snippet: Cerrado Gold Inc. (TSXV: CERT) reported July 13 that its Minera Don Nicolas mine in Patagonian Argentina produced 15,415 gold-equivalent ounces in Q2 2026 — 11% above Q2 2025's 13,835 GEO — bringing first-half 2026 to 28,257 GEO, a 25% improvement over H1 2025's 22,600 GEO as increased underground ore blending and heap leach performance gains drove output higher. Underground development work continued through the quarter, setting up higher-grade ore availability and improved production rates expected in H2 2026; full quarterly financials are expected before August 30.

headline: EVERY RARE EARTH UP IN JULY — 16.7% AVERAGE GAIN ACROSS ALL 18 ELEMENTS; GERMANIUM +27.8%, DYSPROSIUM +25.4%, INDIUM +26.5% IN FIRST BROAD-BASED ADVANCE OF 2026
snippet: July 2026 marks the first truly synchronised advance in rare earth prices this year, with all 18 tracked elements posting gains and an average increase of 16.7% against a median of 18.1% — led by germanium (+27.8%), indium (+26.5%), and heavy rare earth magnet materials dysprosium (+25.4%) and terbium, which have held structurally elevated prices driven by China's April 2025 export restrictions on seven medium and heavy REEs. The synchronised July move suggests that supply tightness has now broadened from the restricted heavy rare earth basket to the full elemental spectrum, with Western manufacturers simultaneously unable to source commercial volumes of multiple elements — a shift that amplifies the strategic case for ex-China primary production projects advancing through prefeasibility and beyond.

headline: 'GOLD AND SILVER HAVE BOTTOMED': GOLDSEEK ANALYSTS CALL END OF SUMMER CORRECTION AFTER $4,001 LOW — CPI CATALYST VALIDATES THE TECHNICAL SETUP
snippet: GoldSeek's latest market analysis argues that gold's pullback to $4,001/oz on July 13 — a roughly 9% correction from January's $5,405 record — constitutes a completed corrective structure that resolved the summer-seasonal weakness window while laying down a higher low relative to prior correction cycles. The July 14 June CPI print, which came in negative on a monthly basis for the first time in 18 months, validated the technical setup by collapsing rate-hike odds and producing the kind of catalyst-driven reversal that typically launches the next sustained leg in bull markets; the piece argues investors who waited for confirmation have a narrowing window before the autumn seasonal advance closes the re-entry opportunity.

headline: FURY DRILLS BEST GRADE EVER AT EAU CLAIRE — 7.01 g/t OVER 21m IN JAMES BAY QUEBEC; THIRD DRILL RIG MOBILIZED AS HIGH-GRADE SHOOT STAYS OPEN (TSX:FURY)
snippet: Fury Gold Mines Limited (TSX: FURY) released July 13 the second batch of Phase 2 assay results from Eau Claire in the Eeyou Istchee Territory, James Bay Region of Northern Quebec — highlight hole 26EC-115 returned 7.01 g/t gold over 21.0 metres, including 10.27 g/t over 11.0 metres, the highest grade per intercept of comparable true thickness in the project's history. Fury simultaneously mobilized a third diamond drill rig, accelerating a campaign that has now produced its single strongest hole just as the high-grade shoot remains open in multiple directions; the combination of a historic-grade intercept and expanded drilling capacity reinforces the company's confidence that Eau Claire has not yet defined its limits.

headline: ABRASILVER PUNCHES 109m AT 221 g/t SILVER IN VIRGIN OCULTO WEST GAP — DIABLILLOS DFS MINE PLAN SET TO EXPAND AS HIGH-GRADE EXTENDS BEYOND PIT BOUNDARY (TSX:ABRA)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / AbraSilver Resource Corp.
snippet: AbraSilver Resource Corp. (TSX: ABRA) released July 13 results from hole DDH 26-036 at Oculto West — a previously undrilled gap in the Diablillos silver-gold project in Salta Province, Argentina — returning 109.0 metres at 221.2 g/t silver and 0.72 g/t gold from 114.0 metres downhole, including 14.0 metres at 580 g/t Ag. The intercept sits within and adjacent to the conceptual open pit modelled in the project's Definitive Feasibility Study, demonstrating high-grade silver-gold mineralisation remains open in a gap the Phase VI resource model had not yet captured and directly pointing to expansion of both the resource and mine plan. Diablillos already carries a DFS-stage silver-gold project with strong project economics; the Oculto West gap result is the kind of post-DFS discovery that can materially improve a project's NPV before construction.

headline: SITKA DRILLS 348m AT 1.12 g/t AU — 5.1 Moz YUKON GOLD SYSTEM KEEPS EXPANDING AS SIX RIGS ATTACK BLACKJACK ON 60,000m CAMPAIGN (TSXV:SIG)
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Sitka Gold Corp.
snippet: Sitka Gold Corp. (TSXV: SIG) announced July 13 assay results from hole DDRCCC-26-128 at the Blackjack deposit within the RC Gold Project in Yukon — returning 348.0 metres at 1.12 g/t gold, including 164.0 metres at 1.83 g/t, 45.0 metres at 3.49 g/t, and high-grade sub-intervals of 2.0 metres at 15.35 g/t and 2.0 metres at 13.65 g/t. Sitka has completed 24,000 metres in 47 holes of its planned 60,000-metre 2026 campaign across six active rigs at the RC Gold Project, which already hosts a 5.1 million ounce gold resource; the continued width and grade at Blackjack suggest the deposit remains meaningfully open at depth and along strike, with 36,000 metres still to be drilled in the current program.
